questions.q: What does an MPPT controller do?
choices: converts DC to AC for the grid
tracks the array's maximum-power point as conditions change
why: No — that is the inverter's role, not the MPPT's.
Correct! MPPT holds the array at its peak-power point as irradiance/temperature vary.
No — that describes a battery, not an MPPT.

questions.q: A 1 m² panel at ~20% efficiency under ~1 kW/m² of sun outputs about:
why: No — that is only ~2% efficiency; recompute 20% of 1 kW.
Correct! 20% of ~1 kW/m² ≈ 200 W from a 1 m² panel.
No — that would exceed the ~1 kW/m² of incoming sunlight.

questions.q: Which metric best compares the lifetime cost of power options?
why: No — peak wattage ignores fuel, lifetime and energy yield.
Correct! LCOE = lifetime cost ÷ lifetime kWh — the fair comparison.
No — colour has nothing to do with cost of energy.
